note: The only authority that may hold a leg or a registered test receipt at not_run. A receipt may only be printed when the recomputed unavailability codes it names are exactly the codes this file registers, compared in both directions: a code the gate computes but this file does not name, or a code named here that is no longer true, makes the real leg run instead. Deleting an entry re-runs the leg; a registration can never make a leg permanently not_run. review_by is an expiry: scripts/verify-ci-leg-receipts.js fails once it has passed.
